name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the hard goal, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) gives the task's 'open the door, then take the box' order; the hard chain forces door_open, so no separate Existence is needed. Absence(key_lost) is soft, matching 'try not to', and key_lost is the drop-while-closed event the task names. The machine routes target-before-door to the rejecting state and penalizes key_lost softly.

texts: The agent must pick up the mission's target box in the other room.
The door must be opened before the target box is taken.
Preferably the agent should not drop the key while the door is still closed.
